checks.name: The physiology contract has exactly two equal phases and no configurable holding phase
The tool is explicitly physiological, starts idle and includes comfort and not-treatment instructions
All three source links resolve to in-page references and no unsupported individual outcome is promised
Layout fits at 320, 390, 820 and 1440 pixels with a usable Stop target
Keyboard activation starts immediately with inhale, reaches exhale at five seconds and inhale at ten without a hold
Stopping cancels the guide and restores keyboard focus without storing a session
Motion can be turned off while the guide remains usable through words
A hidden-page event stops the guide and returning does not restart it
Page exit and a persisted return leave the guide stopped
The guide never reads or writes web storage, fetches data or creates cookies
Reduced-motion preference disables animation initially and cannot be overridden accidentally
A mismatched content layer cannot start the physiological controller

limitations: Desktop Chromium with narrow viewport emulation only. No physical iPhone, Safari, VoiceOver or human usability acceptance.
Visibility suspension is tested with a synthetic hidden-state event; mobile background timing needs a real-device check.
Research copy awaits independent review; browser checks do not establish clinical efficacy or safety for an individual.
